note: Petitions from the crown's own settlements. Conditions pick a fitting settlement ({place}). Effects: treasury, trust (M22 D, was authority), opinion (by group), and for the settlement: unrest, tension, faith (shift in percentage points); sympathy moves Scoia'tael sympathy. The default choice is taken if the petition is ignored.

fire_preacher.title: A preacher of the Eternal Fire
fire_preacher.text: A preacher of the Eternal Fire draws crowds in the square at {place}, railing against sorcerers, heretics and the non-humans who live among honest folk.

hospice.title: A hospice for the sick
hospice.text: The priestesses of Melitele at {place} ask for two hundred and fifty crowns to open a hospice for the sick and the destitute.

grove.title: The old grove
grove.text: The villagers of {place} beg leave to keep the old grove at the edge of their fields. The priests of the Fire want it felled and burned.

quarter.title: The non-human quarter
quarter.text: Townsfolk of {place} demand that the dwarven and elven quarter be walled off and its gates shut at dusk.

elf_youths.title: Gone to the woods
elf_youths.text: Young elves from {place} have vanished into the forest with bows and little else. Their elders say nothing at all.

pilgrim_escort.title: Pilgrims on the road
pilgrim_escort.text: Pilgrims bound for the Temple of Melitele gather at {place}, afraid of the road ahead. They ask the crown for an escort.

dwarven_forge.title: A dwarven forge
dwarven_forge.text: Dwarven smiths at {place} want to build a great forge inside the walls. The human guild says the noise and the competition are intolerable.
